title: Wait for the Instrumentality attempts instead of a fixed 400 ms
goal: The daily-run test no longer depends on runner speed
acceptance: The test waits until both attempts happened, then a settle time, and still expects exactly 2
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20 from the Windows CI log. Not a measurement.
